description: Source code defining the Swift struct 'IOSGatewayChatTransport' that implements the 'OpenClawChatTransport' protocol, facilitating chat transport functionalities such as sending messages, managing sessions, and handling events in an iOS application.

classes.name: IOSGatewayChatTransport
classes.description: A struct that manages chat transport operations in an iOS app, conforming to 'OpenClawChatTransport' and 'Sendable' protocols, with methods for sending messages, managing sessions, and handling events.

methods.name: abortRun
methods.description: Asynchronously aborts a chat run session given session key and run ID.

methods.name: listSessions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of chat sessions, with optional limit.

methods.name: setActiveSessionKey
methods.description: Sets the active session key (no implementation for operator clients).

methods.name: resetSession
methods.description: Resets a chat session identified by the session key.

methods.name: compactSession
methods.description: Compacts a chat session to reduce its size.

methods.name: requestHistory
methods.description: Fetches the message history for a given session.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message along with optional attachments within a session, with logging and error handling.

methods.name: requestHealth
methods.description: Checks the health status of the gateway within a specified timeout.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Returns an asynchronous stream of chat transport events, such as tick, seqGap, health, chat, and agent.
